name: Selective Intrauterine Growth Restriction

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: ISUOG Criteria for Selective Intrauterine Growth Restriction

criteria.description: Estimated fetal weight discordance ≥25% between twins
Abnormal umbilical artery Doppler velocimetry in the smaller twin
Oligohydramnios in the growth-restricted twin with normal fluid in the co-twin

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of estimated fetal weight discordance ≥25% plus abnormal umbilical artery Doppler in the smaller twin
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis applies specifically to monochorionic twin pregnancies

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of significant inter-twin vascular anastomoses causing volume imbalance
Polyhydramnios in recipient twin and oligohydramnios in donor twin
Absence of significant growth discordance without Doppler abnormalities
Symmetric or asymmetric growth restriction without twin discordance

redFlags: Absent or reversed end-diastolic flow in umbilical artery
